text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen and taking steps to reduce their impact. The first step is to identify risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you need mitigation strategies, which are actions that lower the chance or effect of these risks. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution if things fail. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. By checking regularly, you can respond quickly and keep problems under control.
